name: The majority voted against a motion that opposes the [bill](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r5906) because, according to the motion, *"it places the Government's political interests ahead of the interests of Australia’s farmers"*. The motion was introduced by Labor MP [Joel Fitzgibbon](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/hunter/joel_fitzgibbon). ### Motion text > *That all words after 'That' be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > *'the House declines to give this bill a second reading as it places the Government's political interests ahead of the interests of Australia’s farmers'*
